title: Program Overview Readability Cleanup

reasons: Latest screenshots show the Program Overview route still mixes bright generic cards into the dark One Time shell.
The route is the first Rabbi workspace landing state, so uneven panels make the project feel unfinished.
The fix is visual and can be scoped to the existing route marker and One Time Operations CSS.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time Program Overview route feel even and loaded by replacing bright generic overview panels with contained readable One Time admin panels.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

affected_surfaces: One Time Operations Program Overview route

inspection_targets: public/css/one-time-operations.css One Time Program route overrides
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The Program Overview route contains a bright metric summary card beside the dark hero.
The Mishnayos Membership detail panel and its detail tiles render as bright generic cards inside the dark One Time route surface.
The Command Bot Actions panel and no-actions state render as a large bright card instead of a proportionate dark panel.

expanded_phrases.clean: The Program Overview should render as a cohesive One Time admin dashboard with readable dark panels and no bright generic-card islands.
expanded_phrases.even: The route heading, metric summary, Mishnayos Membership detail grid, note, and Command Bot panel should share spacing, contrast, borders, and dark One Time surfaces.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: After Operations data loads, the first Program Overview screen should immediately present readable summary and membership information without visual style jumps or horizontal overflow.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The route remains a first-party BNA Operations provider workspace view scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix the One Time Program Overview readability so the metric summary, Mishnayos Membership detail panel, and Command Bot panel use contained readable One Time styling.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile Program Overview screenshots show one cohesive dark route surface with readable metrics, membership details, and bot preview/empty state, with no horizontal overflow.
acceptance_criteria: The existing Program Overview route marker is used for scoped styling.
The overview metric summary renders as dark readable buttons/cards that keep labels, values, and notes inside their bounds.
The Mishnayos Membership panel, detail cards, and admin-only note are readable on a dark One Time panel.
The Command Bot Actions panel and no-actions state are compact, dark, readable, and proportionate on desktop and mobile.
Navigation, bot preview, payment, access, provider, participant, communications, route access, and external-provider guardrails are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current screenshot evidence shows the Program Overview bright-card readability defects.
The route already has data-one-time-program-route="overview" for scoped CSS targeting.
No payment, access, bot mutation, provider setup, credential, account, privacy, legal, or financial decision is required for local visual implementation.
